summary: Iteration 83 — Backend + Web are green; Mobile Expo web preview is a HARD BLOCKER (stuck on auth-splash forever). Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (fees+tax quote/checkout persistence, nearby distance-sorted mixed categories, merchant fulfillment GET/PATCH round-trip, admin tax CRUD, AI estimate via Emergent LLM). Web: /shop/near-me, /shop/order/{id}, /shop/merchant/fulfillment, /admin/tax all render with the correct data-testids and expected data (fees, ETA, tracker code, seeded rules AE 5% / US-CA 7.25% / US-CA-LA 9.5%). Web /shop/checkout/menu could not be visually verified because the cart was empty after the item-option-confirm flow — needs a look at whether ItemOptionModal correctly writes to the cart store from the ShopMenu 'menu-add' entry (or if a default option was already selected we should surface differently). Mobile: demo-login-btn NEVER RENDERS — root layout stays on <ActivityIndicator testID='auth-splash'/> indefinitely; no /api/auth/me call is ever fired, no console error, no pageerror. Persists across a full `sudo supervisorctl restart mobile`. Very likely regression from this iteration's new zustand `persist` middleware wiring in /app/mobile/src/stores/useCartStore.ts (imports @react-native-async-storage/async-storage which on web sometimes hangs rehydration). Because of this blocker, none of the mobile items (cart persistence, cart-fulfillment/pickup/eta/service-fee/tax, near-me gate, tracker fallback, orders list fulfillment+ETA) could be exercised this pass.

Recommend a `skipHydration: true` + explicit `useCartStore.persist.rehydrate()` after the AuthContext resolves, or a web-only createJSONStorage(() => localStorage-adapter).

rca of the issue: Mobile auth-splash hang: mobile app root layout (/app/mobile/app/_layout.tsx) gates all screens on AuthContext.loading. AuthProvider boot useEffect runs `await loadToken(); await refresh(); setLoading(false);` — but NO /api/auth/me network call ever fires (no requests in network log). Combined with (i) the new persist middleware wrapping useCartStore with AsyncStorage rehydration and (ii) no console/page errors, the most likely cause is that a module-level import (e.g. AsyncStorage on web, or a cart-side effect) is throwing/hanging synchronously before the AuthContext effect runs, or that persist rehydration is throwing an unhandled promise rejection that stalls the JS event loop for the boot phase. Mitigation: gate persist with `skipHydration:true` and hydrate on-demand from a screen that mounts *after* auth, OR provide a web-safe custom storage adapter (localStorage) instead of AsyncStorage on Platform.OS==='web'.
